name: Datin' Nantes
source:
Datin' Nantes is a humorous dating visual novel. Following a messy breakup and a crypto crash in Lyon, protagonist Guigui moves to Nantes for a "remontada express". The gameplay revolves around choosing between Plan A (hitting the nightclub) or Plan B (using a dating app) to find a new soulmate. You interact with various characters through branching dialogue options, managing both SMS exchanges and in-person dates. High affinity levels unlock exclusive cutscenes where the game's focus shifts entirely to your intimate connection. However, poor decisions can trigger unique Game Overs.

[From [url=https://meyaxu.itch.io/datin-nantes]itch[/url]]
translation:
《约会南特》是一部幽默的约会视觉小说。在里昂经历了混乱的分手和加密货币崩溃之后，主角Guigui搬到南特乘坐“remontadaexpress”。游戏玩法围绕在A计划（去夜总会）或B计划（使用约会应用程序）之间进行选择来寻找新的灵魂伴侣。你可以通过分支对话选项与各种角色互动，管理短信交换和面对面约会。高亲和力等级可解锁独特的过场动画，游戏的焦点完全转移到你们的亲密联系上。然而，糟糕的决定可能会引发独特的游戏结束。

[来自[url=https://meyaxu.itch.io/datin-nantes]itch[/url]]
